section:
### A further comparison between arms

Standard care is the usual blood pressure treatment given to every patient. Alvenor is a once daily tablet that relaxes the walls of the blood vessels. Cardivel is a tablet that slows the heart so it pushes with less force. All data for this comparison were collected at the Maplewood Cardiac Group.

Table 4. The measure for each arm, shown subset by subset.

| Subset | Arm | Measure | Count | Total |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Younger adults, Normal kidney function, University hospital | Standard care | Side effects | 169 | 650 |
| Younger adults, Normal kidney function, University hospital | Alvenor | Side effects | 102 | 650 |
| Younger adults, Normal kidney function, University hospital | Cardivel | Side effects | 220 | 650 |

Each group is reported in the same way for every measure.
